summary: Core pedagogical philosophy, commitment to science equity, and forward-looking five-year trajectory.

philosophy.title: Inquiry as an Act of Liberation and Community Stewardship
philosophy.statement: True science education does not happen when students merely memorize taxonomies or recite equations. It occurs when a student asks a question about their immediate environment—a polluted riverbank, crop blight in a family garden, or erratic weather patterns—and possesses both the scientific rigor and the moral courage to investigate it. My classroom is designed as a laboratory of civic inquiry, where every learner is treated as an active researcher and every failure in experimental design is celebrated as essential empirical feedback.

pillars.title: Constructivist Inquiry (5E Learning Cycle)
pillars.description: Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, and Evaluate. Learners formulate hypotheses before theories are formally codified.

pillars.title: Curriculum Localization & Contextualization
pillars.description: Utilizing Philippine ecological systems, indigenous knowledge systems, and local community issues to ground scientific concepts.

pillars.title: Democratic Digital Literacy
pillars.description: Leveraging free and open-source scientific tools, digital simulations (PhET), and reproducible research methods regardless of socio-economic barriers.

five_year_plan.target: Completion of MAEd Thesis & International Conference Presentation
five_year_plan.details: Defend thesis on localized science inquiry modules and submit for peer review in Scopus-indexed educational journals.
Consolidate demonstration teaching, division-level learning material authoring, and action research accomplishments.

five_year_plan.target: Institutionalizing an Open Science Maker Lab in the STE Program
five_year_plan.details: Partner with SUCs and DOST to establish low-cost environmental sensor stations maintained entirely by student researchers.

five_year_plan.target: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Science Education Entry
five_year_plan.details: Pursue advanced doctoral studies focusing on computational thinking and STEM pedagogical innovations in public high schools.
